05/ 21.07.2023.

Petitioner above-named has moved this Court for grant of regular bail in
connection with S.T. No.237 of 2023 (Dhanwar P.S. Case No.01 of 2023, M.C.A. No.830 of 2023)
registered under Sections 341, 342, 376, 506, 452 of the Indian Penal Code.
Heard the parties.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the victim is a major married lady and the incidence as per the FIR, took place in her own house and continued throughout the night and when her sister-in-law (Nanad) got up and started crying, the family members gathered and caught the petitioner.

It is submitted that it is highly improbable that the incidence took place in the dwelling house of the victim lady and she had no opportunity to raise alarm or call for the rescue of other family members.
Learned APP for the State assisted by learned counsel for the informant has vehemently opposed the prayer.
It is submitted that there is direct and specific allegation that the petitioner was caught red-handed in the house by the family members.
Considering the submissions of learned counsel and the fact as discussed above, the bail application is allowed.

Accordingly, the petitioner named above shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below and subject to the condition that one of the bailor(s) must be Sikandar Rai @ Sikandar Kr. Rai vs The State Of Jharkhand.
